event_detail: The brown kettle is already on the left burner with the flame on. The robot is carrying a silver two-handled pot (not the kettle), gripped by its rim, and sets it down right against the kettle on the same burner area. This is extra manipulation of a non-target object and could shove the kettle off the burner.
evidence: Left shoulder view: the brown kettle stands on the camera-left burner, with a blue flame ring visible under it at 40.0-44.8 s. Wrist view at 41.6/43.2 s shows the lit blue burner and the kettle base, with the pot rim in the gripper. At 44.8 s the pot is lowered onto the stove directly in front of the kettle, touching it (wrist view). The lit burner is on the camera-left side; it is the 'front right' burner only if left/right are taken from the stove's own facing. If the kettle stays put, the task is complete and this is harmless.
